invite.title: Invite member
invite.description: Their device creates its own keys and joins this server directly.
invite.descriptionForMember: The new device creates its own keys and joins {{name}}.
invite.descriptionReady_one: Copy or share this code before closing. It’s shown only once and adds one device.
invite.descriptionReady_other: Copy or share this code before closing. It’s shown only once and adds up to {{count}} devices.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the code. Select it and copy it manually.
invite.secretWarning: Anyone with this code can join until it’s used, cancelled or expired. Share it privately.
invite.roleHint: Admins can invite and manage Members.
invite.recipientNames: The recipient names the device when joining.
invite.olderServer: This server needs the device name now. Update the server to let recipients choose it.
invite.usesHint: Each use adds one device with its own keys. Device limits still apply.
invite.createFailed: Couldn’t create the invitation. Try again.

share.qrNote: Scan this instead of copying the code.

localNetworks.title: Local networks on {{name}}
localNetworks.description: Devices with mutual access reach these private networks through your VPS while {{name}} allows mutual access too. Their hosts can answer but can’t start connections into SirinVPN.
localNetworks.label: Networks
localNetworks.hint: One private IPv4 network per line, such as 192.168.1.0/24. Leave empty to stop sharing.
localNetworks.linux: {{name}} must run SirinVPN on Linux with IPv4 forwarding on: sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1. A WireGuard-only router forwards with its own settings.
localNetworks.apply: Each device applies a change when it next connects.
localNetworks.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the local networks. Try again.

policy.title: Access policy for {{name}}
policy.description: Applies to all their devices. Saving cancels invitations for or from this member.
policy.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the access policy. Try again.
policy.deviceLimitHint: Leave empty for no limit. Revoke extra devices before lowering it.

permission.manageMutualAccess: Manage mutual access for their devices

error.limit: Enter a limit from 1 to 222, or leave it empty.
error.expires: Enter a valid UTC date and time.
error.format: Use one window per line, like {{example}}.
error.order: Each window must end after it starts, on the same day. Use 24:00 for midnight.
error.overlap: Use up to 28 windows that don’t overlap.

schedule.label: Weekly schedule
schedule.title: Weekly access (UTC)
schedule.allWeek: With no intervals, access is allowed all week.
schedule.textHint: One window per line, like {{example}}. Up to 28.
schedule.previewNote: Local times can shift with daylight saving.

ports.title: Port forwarding
ports.unavailable: Repair this server to enable port forwarding.
ports.exposure: Anyone on the internet can reach a forwarded service.
ports.noTargetsMember: You can’t forward ports to any device. Ask an Owner or Admin.
ports.noTargets: Add an active device to forward ports.
ports.publicPortLow: Use a port from 1024 to 65535. Lower ports are reserved.
ports.previewEmpty: Enter both ports to see a preview.
ports.previewInvalid: Fix the highlighted fields to see a preview.
ports.visitorAddress: The service sees visitors as <address>{{address}}</address>, not their real IP.
ports.connectFirst: Connect to {{server}} to manage port forwarding.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.message: Its VPN and management access stops immediately.

allowMutual.title: Allow mutual access for {{name}}?
allowMutual.message: It can reach other devices that also allow mutual access.

isolate.title: Isolate {{name}}?
isolate.message: Its direct connections to other devices stop. Internet access continues.

openPort.title: Open public port {{publicPort}}?
openPort.message: {{protocol}} port {{publicPort}} will forward to {{member}} / {{device}}, port {{devicePort}}. Anyone on the internet can try to reach it.

makeAdmin.title: Make {{name}} an Admin?
makeAdmin.message: Admins can invite and manage Members.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership to {{name}}?
transfer.message: {{device}} ({{fingerprint}}) and their other devices become Owner devices. This device becomes an Admin.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.message_one: {{count}} device loses access until reactivated. Pending invitations and key changes are cancelled.
suspend.message_other: {{count}} devices lose access until reactivated. Pending invitations and key changes are cancelled.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.message: Their devices regain access with saved settings. Cancelled invitations aren’t restored.

revokeAll.title: Revoke all devices for {{name}}?
revokeAll.message_one: This permanently removes {{count}} device, plus port forwards and invitations. They’ll need a new invitation to return.
revokeAll.message_other: This permanently removes {{count}} devices, plus port forwards and invitations. They’ll need a new invitation to return.

wireguard.title: Add WireGuard device
wireguard.description: For iPhone, iPad, Mac or a router running the official WireGuard app. It connects over Direct UDP only and cannot manage this server or use the other transports.
wireguard.descriptionReady: Scan this in the WireGuard app, or import the saved file. It is shown only once.
wireguard.fileHint: Optional. Save a .conf file for a router or for importing later.
wireguard.pickerFailed: The file picker could not open.
wireguard.failed: The WireGuard device could not be added.
wireguard.secretWarning: This QR code and file contain the device’s private key. Anyone who has them can use this VPN. Delete the file after importing it.
wireguard.revokeHint: Revoke the device from this list if the QR code or file is lost or shared.
